$comment: Lamo Stories' own model list (docs/CONTRACTS.md §45.25, ADR-77). Separate from config/models.json, which is Clip Factory's and is never read by Lamo Stories. Terraform builds the Lamo Stories agent's bedrock:InvokeModel grants from this file. 'profile' is the inference profile the agent calls; 'regions' are that profile's destination Regions (for IAM; '*' for a global profile). 'efforts' are the output_config.effort levels the model accepts (empty: no effort setting, the model runs at its own level). 'pricing' is null when no price is known for this account: Bedrock prices are partner prices and differ from Anthropic's own list, so the owner may type them in Lamo Stories › Settings › AI. The owner's 'Sable 5.2 / Sable 5.1' are the Claude Fable 5.2 / 5.1 models below.

models.label: Claude Fable 5.2
models.line: The most capable. Best for storyboards and hard reasoning.

models.label: Claude Fable 5.1
models.line: Very capable. The model Clip Factory uses by default (a separate setting).

models.label: Claude Opus 5.5
models.line: Smart and quicker. A good default for creative work.

models.label: Claude Haiku 5.5
models.line: Cheapest and fastest. For quick edits.
